description: Chloride induced rebar corrosion model inputs for bridge deck corrosion-fatigue coupling.

faraday_model.form: Corrosion penetration rate p in mm/year equals 0.0116 * i_corr in uA/cm^2 for iron.
faraday_model.source: Andrade and Alonso 1996, Construction and Building Materials. Standard Faraday conversion for steel in concrete.

mild.label: Low active corrosion, inland de-icing salt exposure

severe.label: High active corrosion, marine splash zone

i_corr_source: FHWA corrosion of reinforcing steel field data, marine and de-icing exposure.

pitting_factor.note: Ratio of maximum pit depth to uniform corrosion depth for chloride induced pitting. Used to convert uniform loss into an equivalent surface crack starter.

nbi_condition_rating_scale.structurally_deficient_rule: Deck, superstructure, or substructure rating of 4 or less.
